Thanks for the heads-up, Elena — I reviewed the procurement redlines. This thread becomes our working risk log entry. Quick summary and proposed mitigations:

Risk: Procurement/legal review pushes MSA sign-off ~3 weeks, delaying full acceptance and go-live.
Impact: Original go-live window (week of Jun 21) is at risk; customer-facing pilot and data onboarding timelines slip. Potential cost exposure if reserved capacity is pre-provisioned.
Mitigations proposed (short list):
- Canary path A: Limited pilot under an LOA (letter of authorization) — engineering can enable a sandbox with production-like data masking to start functional tests.
- Canary path B: Scoped feature pilot (read-only embeddings + small test corpus) that avoids ingress of PHI until MSA is signed.
- Financial: Offer a one-time credit for unused reserved capacity or allow shifting of reserved start date inside contract (requires legal sign-off).

I’ve updated the MAP to v2 (attached) to include conditional milestones for an LOA-based pilot and added a risk register row (Gimbal_risk_log_20260518.csv). Please review and confirm preferred mitigation.

1) Avery — confirm whether Optimus is open to an LOA for a sandbox pilot (Elena/Sam).
2) Priyom — can you prepare a short pricing impact note (delta for 3-week shift + credit options) by EOD tomorrow?
3) Laura — if we escalate, would you be comfortable with a provisional credit approval up to $8k to bridge the reservation cost while legal finishes review?

Elena / Team —

Thank you for raising the procurement constraint and sharing the redlines. We want to keep momentum for Optimus while respecting legal and procurement constraints. After internal review I’m authorizing a provisional rebaseline with the following conditions:

1) Rebaseline: Move formal go-live acceptance window from week of Jun 21 to week of Jul 12 (three-week push). This is provisional pending final legal sign-off but gives both teams updated operational dates to plan against.

2) Canary pilot: Redwood will support an LOA-based sandbox pilot by Jun 1 provided Optimus signs the LOA and limits dataset to non-PHI test data or masked PHI. Engineering will deliver a canary checklist and a short runbook for the pilot environment.

3) Financial: I approve a provisional credit hold of up to $8,000 to cover reserved-capacity exposure for the three-week shift. This credit is conditional on final contract language and will be applied to the first invoice after go-live. Finance will quantify any delta in a follow-up note.

4) Escalation / decision path: If legal sign-off extends beyond Jul 12, the parties will reconvene in a mandatory steering call (within 48 hours of notification) to determine next steps, including extended credits or alternate deployment sequencing.

5) Owners & deadlines:
- Procurement/legal (Optimus): complete redline resolution by Jun 18.
- Avery (Redwood AE): confirm LOA acceptance by May 22.
- Priyom (Redwood Pricing): provide formal delta pricing/credit note by May 19 EOD.
- Camila (CS): own pilot runbook and readiness checklist.

Please reply-all to confirm acceptance of these conditions. Once I have a confirmation from Optimus and Avery we’ll update the MAP officially to v2 and record the risk closure steps.
